anya_cs: Quick draft for 4 impacted accounts  please review (legal/ops). We want to send within 30m. @mike_success @dan_ops

mike_success: Include exact phrasing about a one-time pro-rated billing adjustment and say how it appears on the invoice.

dan_ops: Ops summary: spike at ~09:45 UTC, routed to warm reserved pool at 09:53 UTC. Backfill running; expect full catch-up within 6 hours. No data moved across regions.

sam_onboard: I'll run the offer of a 30-min tuning session and handle scheduling. Slot options: Mon 10-12 PT, Tue 14-16 PT.

anya_cs: Draft note to send from cs@redwood:
"Hi <CustomerName>,

Wanted to update you about a short interruption to embeddings ingestion that began ~09:45 UTC today. To restore throughput we routed affected workloads to reserved warm capacity at 09:53 UTC; this cleared the backlog but you may see slightly higher latency while we finish backfilling.

What were doing:
- Regional fallback to reserved capacity (completed)
- Targeted retries/backfill (in progress)
- RCA to follow within 72 hours

Billing: We will apply a one-time pro-rated invoice adjustment for measurable impact during the affected window; your CS rep will confirm details.

Offer: Complimentary 30-min tuning session: <calendar-link>.

If this affects a live workflow, reply and well escalate.

Thanks,
Redwood CS"

mike_success: LGTM. dan_ops, confirm ops notes in the email?

dan_ops: Confirmed. No cross-region movement; KV cache intact.

srebot: Incident 2801233000  Embedded ingestion degraded; mitigation active. Status: monitoring.
